en.title: Electronics & Retail: Endless Pricing & Stock Inquiries
en.problem: Customers constantly message your Telegram or call asking 'What is the price of this laptop?' or 'Is this phone in stock?', consuming hours of your day with repetitive back-and-forth chats.

en.title: Content Creators & Artists: Algorithm Traps & Fragmented Links
en.problem: Social media platforms throttle your organic reach, while generic 'link-in-bio' tools look amateurish and cannot stream high-quality audio/video, showcase full albums, or process bookings.

en.title: Print & Service Shops: Malware & Disorganized Client Files
en.problem: Walk-in clients bringing flash drives infect your workstations with viruses, while custom order details (pages, binding style, paper grade) get scrambled across manual chats.

en.title: Service Providers: Invisibility to Corporate & High-Value Clients
en.problem: Companies, NGOs, and institutions look online for verified local service providers, suppliers, and contractors, but take their business to competitors because you lack a fast, authoritative website.

en.title: Fragile WordPress Templates & Heavy Dollar Hosting Bills
en.problem: Most agencies sell slow, vulnerable templates that crash on Ethiopian 3G/4G networks and demand $80–$150/year in scarce foreign currency just to keep the servers online.
